correctness.rationale: For every fixed tau>0, the piecewise-linear L² spline mass matrix gives Jacobi Q=6M with diagonal 4 except nodes 0,1, where it is 2(1+tau), and off-diagonal 1 except the exceptional edge tau. Conjugation by alternating signs gives a positive exponentially decaying Green inverse, with r=2-sqrt(3). Independently checked the two explicitly proposed Green rows against the junction equations and their factored absolute-integral identities symbolically in Q(sqrt(3)); direct independent evaluations give L_0(1/2)-2≈0.04824942>0, L_{-1}(2)-2≈0.04514007>0. For 0<tau<1 the former has numerator 3tau(1-tau²); for tau>1 the latter has (tau²-1), with every other factor positive. At tau=1 translation-invariant Green rows yield all knot Lebesgue values 2, and convexity bounds between knots, proving iff. Does NOT claim the exact nonunit global norm or maximizing knot.
